description: This file defines a PHP interface named 'Mail' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Mail'. It specifies methods for retrieving email components such as recipients, subject, body, and content type, intended to be implemented by classes that handle email functionalities in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: A PHP interface declaring methods related to email message components, to be implemented by email handling classes in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getToList
methods.description: Returns an array of recipient email addresses.

methods.name: getCcList
methods.description: Returns an array of CC recipient email addresses or null.

methods.name: getBccList
methods.description: Returns an array of BCC recipient email addresses or null.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email subject as a string or null.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the email body content as a string or null.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the email as a string or null.
